name: Sprout Early Learning
tagline: A calm, sunlit place for little ones to play, learn, and grow — from six weeks to kindergarten.
hours_note: Closed on federal holidays and two teacher-planning days a year
enrollment_note: Now enrolling for fall — a few spots left in Toddlers and Pre-K.

testimonial.quote: Our daughter runs in every morning. The teachers send photos at lunch and know exactly what she's been curious about all week.
testimonial.name: Maya R.

day.title: Gentle arrivals
day.body: Breakfast, a warm hello, and quiet play while friends trickle in.

day.title: Circle and discovery
day.body: Songs, a question of the day, then hands-on centers — blocks, art, science.

day.title: Garden and outdoor play
day.body: Climbing, digging, and tending our raised beds, rain or shine.

day.title: Lunch and rest
day.body: A family-style meal, then a story and a nap in a calm, dim room.

day.title: Snack and projects
day.body: Small-group projects, music and movement, and more time outside.

day.title: Pick-up and a daily note
day.body: A photo and a few lines about the day, sent before you arrive.

included: Daily photo updates in the parent app

art_direction.identity: A calm, sunlit early-learning house: pale linen-sage canvas, deep leaf-green type and bands, soft rounded photographs of real classroom moments. Warm and elegant, never a primary-color cartoon.
art_direction.type: Fredoka (medium/semibold) for every heading, big and friendly with tight tracking; Figtree for body and UI text.
art_direction.color: One accent: sunflower (bg-primary) for the main call to action and the small rotated sticker words in the hero. Deep leaf green (bg-secondary) carries one or two dark bands. Everything else is canvas, sage surface, ink, and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The growth chart — programs by age laid out like a height chart on a door frame, each column stepping taller from Infants to Pre-K beside a tick-marked ruler. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, plain, reassuring, specific. Parents are busy and a little anxious — short sentences, concrete details (ratios, meals, times), no exclamation points, no jargon.
